Let me analyze the PFN results:

- median_prediction: mean 0.9366 (far from tipping on average), first_third_mean 0.9991 (very far at start), last_third_mean 0.8126 (decreasing but still relatively far), last_window 0.014 (VERY close to tipping at the end!)
- interval_90_width: last_window 1.0093 (very wide uncertainty at the end)
- p_critical: mean 0.0894 (low on average), max 0.8211, last_window 0.8043 (HIGH probability of being critical at the end), last_third_mean 0.1769, share_of_windows_above_half 0.0357

The key insight: the last window has median_prediction of 0.014 (very close to 0 = tipping point) and p_critical of 0.8043 (high probability of being near tipping). The trend shows the system is approaching the tipping point - predictions dropped from 0.9991 in the first third to 0.014 at the last window.

This is a clear alert situation. The end of the series looks close to tipping.

Decision: alert
Confidence: high, given p_critical of 0.8043 at the last window and median prediction of 0.014.
